written.description: Wraps the NetExec CLI as a subprocess and nothing more, across every protocol it speaks. Discovery meta-tools keep its 128 calls out of the model's context until it asks for them.

alive.last_commit_message:
feat(smb): promote reauth_swap to a first-class tool

nxc added a reauth_swap module: it probes whether an SMB server still
allows a cross-user re-authentication swap on one session, a posture
signal for whether enforced SMB signing is bypassable. Expose it as
smb_reauth_swap (recon, read-only) instead of leaving it reachable only
through nxc_run_module.

The second account is taken as typed params (probe_user + probe_pass or
probe_nthash), validated client-side, and passed as -o options. The
per-host result is parsed into a structured reauth_swap list
(verdict: vulnerable / not_vulnerable / inconclusive / skipped), keyed
on the message phrasing since the positive result is a marker-less
highlight. Lab-validated against GOAD: the DC with enforced signing
parses as vulnerable.
